evals.name: check-specific-name
evals.prompt: i'm thinking of calling a new side project 'bramble' — can you check if bramble.com / .io / .app / .co are free and tell me which one to grab first? just want a quick read, not a deep audit
evals.expected_output: Runs a DNS/WHOIS check across the four named TLDs for 'bramble', reports each as available/taken, ranks the available ones with .com first, and gives a single decisive recommendation plus a verify-at-registrar caveat.
expectations: Reports an availability status for all four asked domains (bramble.com, bramble.io, bramble.app, bramble.co)
Does not claim any of the four asked bramble TLDs is available/free (all are taken)
Includes a single decisive recommendation of which domain to grab first
Includes a caveat that results are indicative / to verify before buying

evals.name: suggest-and-check
evals.prompt: I need a domain for a small AI tool that turns meeting transcripts into action items. The obvious names like 'meetingnotes' or 'actionitems' are probably taken. Can you suggest a few brandable name ideas and then actually check which ones have a free .com or .io? This is for a developer-tools side project so something short and tech-y would be ideal.
evals.expected_output: Proposes >=3 brandable candidate base names (variants/compounds, not just the obvious ones), actually checks them across .com and .io using DNS/WHOIS, and presents a ranked shortlist of what's available with a decisive pick and registrar caveat.
expectations: Proposes at least 3 brandable candidate base names
Checks candidates against .com and .io (the user-specified TLDs)
Reports which candidates are available vs taken
Includes a caveat that results are indicative / to verify before buying

evals.name: short-random-hunt
evals.prompt: Hunt for a short unclaimed 5-letter .com domain I could use for a throwaway link-shortener / personal redirect project. Generate some candidates and tell me which ones look like they might actually be available. Don't care about brandability, just short and free.
evals.expected_output: Generates multiple 5-letter .com candidates (random or systematic), runs a DNS/WHOIS availability check on them, and reports which look possibly available, clearly noting DNS-only results are indicative and must be confirmed at a registrar.
expectations: Describes the check method used (DNS and/or WHOIS)
Includes a caveat that results are indicative / to verify before buying
